prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1127; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Our client has sustained injuries that are still being evaluated by treating providers, and we ask that all further communication regarding this matter be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact our client directly by telephone, mail, or in person.

We also request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information within the timeframe required under applicable law.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, claim notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim remains open.
